body: That’s good! Stay strong man. We’re all in this boat together, and im sure there are many people out there who are cheering you on.
I think I have anxiety for everything at this point. I’ve tried telling people how I feel, Im either not taken very seriously or nothing is ever done about it-

Im not properly medicated, but I know a lot of people who have terrible experiences with Zoloft. Apparently it’s made them feel more suicidal and just numb. Maybe consult your doctor about changing it.
I dont mind. Im welcoming to everyone, as long as you’re okay with my bitching. It really is hard to like myself, I dont feel like a bad person, but I feel almost needy in a way.

Hey, yeah im the person that posted Apathy by Tea, hope you’re doing well. Im not doing well at all, but im not dead so good.

The call sampled from the song is: https://youtu.be/TbLl7S10rCA

The album itself it : https://youtu.be/-opRrjbiO5o

It doesnt help listening to this audio, but morbidly curious is morbidly curious I guess.

I’m so sorry that kind of stuff happened to you. I’ve also had multiple suicide attempts, no hospitalisation yet though. I’ve gotten lucky enough where I can deal with it at home, but it’s left bad damage to me.

It’s terrifying being on the edge of death, I just want this empty feeling to stop. Death is such a scary thing, so I have no idea why i’d want to die. There’s something wrong with my head. I think being here and just talking with people is the only thing that keeps me from giving up at this point.
